care.helpTitle: A little guidance, whenever you need it
care.helpIntro: Simple answers to help you move forward with confidence.
care.faqPhoto: What makes a good prescription photo?
care.faqPhotoAnswer: Place the prescription on a flat surface in good light. Include the whole page and check that the text is in focus. You can also upload a PDF.
care.faqAfter: What happens after I submit a request?
care.faqAfterAnswer: In a connected service, the pharmacy reviews the prescription and contacts you to confirm availability, cost, and fulfillment. This preview only demonstrates that workflow.
care.faqDeliveryAnswer: Your pharmacy must confirm timing after reviewing the request. A status indicator is not a guarantee of availability or a delivery time.
care.faqUrgent: What if I need urgent help?
care.faqUrgentAnswer: Do not wait for a request update if you need urgent medical help. Contact your care team or local emergency service. Sepan is not an emergency service.
care.faqPrivacy: What happens to files in this preview?
care.faqPrivacyAnswer: Files and contact details stay in browser memory for this session. They are not uploaded or saved and are cleared on refresh. Use sample information only.
care.helpFooter: For questions about your medicines or treatment, contact your pharmacist or care team.
